title: Best AI App Builder for Designers in 2026: Tested Against Real Design Systems
summary: We scored eight AI app builders against what designers actually complain about in 2026: design-system drift, prompt-routed visual editors, and prototypes that get thrown away.
body_markdown: UXPin Forge and Blink are the two real answers here. Forge connects to your Git-synced component library through a dedicated rules engine that constrains every generation to components that actually exist in it. Blink's two-way GitHub sync lets you point it at your existing component repository directly, so the agent builds inside your real codebase, with your pushed updates flowing back in automatically. Figma Make can reference library styling context, a lighter-touch connection. Lovable, Base44, Bolt, Replit, and v0 all generate to their own conventions by default.
